# graphiant_assurance_dnsproxy_entries (Data Source)

Current DNS proxy filter entries for data assurance. Read-only: the API's delete endpoint (V2AssuranceDeleteDnsproxyEntryDelete) has no way to target a specific entry — no path, query, or body parameter identifies which entry to delete — so entries created via this provider would leak permanently with no cleanup path. This is a data source rather than a resource for that reason; manage entries via the portal until the API gains a working delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_assurance_dnsproxy_entries" "all" {}

output "dnsproxy_entry_names" {
  value = [for e in data.graphiant_assurance_dnsproxy_entries.all.entries : e.name]
}
```
